prompt:
Cinematic key art for a prestige driving game, 16:9 widescreen. An independent used-car lot in Houston, Texas, late at night after close, seen from a low camera at knee height standing at the left edge of the lot. Rows of clean late-model sedans, pickups and SUVs are parked in neat diagonal rows angled AWAY from camera, so we see their tail lights, rear quarters and roof lines, never their grilles or front badges; tail lights dark, paint holding long streaks of reflected sodium light. Wet asphalt with long warm reflections from three tall pole lights. On the right side of the frame, a modest single-story sales office with warm light glowing in its windows and a covered entry, its windows plain glass with no lettering. Behind, low palm silhouettes and power lines against a humid deep bottle-green night sky with faint haze; no city skyline, no towers, no billboards. Composition: all subject mass in the right 60 percent of the frame; the left 40 percent falls into calm, deep, almost black shadow of empty wet asphalt, perfect for type. Palette: bottle green shadows (#1C3229 into near-black #0A0F0D), warm sodium amber practical light, bone white highlights (#EDE7DB). Photoreal with painterly restraint, 35mm anamorphic feel, shallow depth of field, fine film grain. Absolutely no people, no readable text, no signage, no letters, no logos, no brand emblems or badges, no license plates, no neon, no lens flares, no bloom, no plastic CGI gloss. (model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst via Figma)
Two small rear badges were inpainted out in code (cv2.inpaint) before grading.
